name: What's Up Docker
description: What's Up Docker (WUD) monitors containers on one or more Docker hosts, detects new image versions, and can notify you or update containers automatically through configurable triggers.

notes.text: The admin login is in /opt/wud/.env (WUD_AUTH_ADMIN_USER / WUD_AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD).
No Docker runs in this container. Add your Docker hosts as watchers in /opt/wud/.env, e.g. WUD_WATCHER_MYHOST_HOST=192.168.1.10, then restart wud.
